command: set -u; echo TIME; date -Is; echo SERVICE; systemctl --user show frankenstein-buehne.service -p MainPID -p ControlGroup -p ExecMainStartTimestamp; echo LISTENER; ss -ltnp 'sport = :8788' 2>&1 || true; echo DAEMONS; pgrep -af 'buehne_daemon.py|8788' || true; echo TREE; MAIN=$(systemctl --user show frankenstein-buehne.service -p MainPID --value); ps -eo pid,ppid,lstart,stat,args | awk -v m="$MAIN" '$1==m || $2==m || /buehne_daemon.py/ || /8788/ {print}'; echo CWD_ENV; for p in $(pgrep -f 'buehne_daemon.py' || true); do echo PID=$p; readlink -f /proc/$p/cwd 2>/dev/null || true; tr '\0' '\n' </proc/$p/environ 2>/dev/null | grep -E '^(PWD|HOME|DISPLAY|XAUTHORITY)=' || true; done; echo CURL_HEADERS; curl -fsSI http://127.0.0.1:8788/augen_blink/blink_000.png || true
